rows.label: bf03370100_0010
rows.name:
Really... Today has been one memory
after another...

rows.label: bf03370100_0020
rows.name:
Just so we're clear, we didn't come here
for a reunion.

rows.label: bf03370100_0030
rows.name: Heaven's Holy Grail has already left.

rows.label: bf03370100_0060
rows.name: It seems your health is quite poor.

rows.label: bf03370100_0070
rows.name:
This town seems to have neither
good doctors nor powerful Blades.

rows.label: bf03370100_0080
rows.name:
Kamui and I could restore the stagnant
ether flow in your body to normal.

rows.label: bf03370100_0100
rows.name:
I don't want this to seem like a
crude business transaction, but[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf03370100_0110
rows.name: This shouldn't be a bad deal for you.

rows.label: bf03370100_0120
rows.name:
Please lend us your
power, just a little.

rows.label: bf03370100_0130
rows.name: Then you'll be able to keep living.

rows.label: bf03370100_0140
rows.name:
I can't cling to life
anymore. I've lived enough.

rows.label: bf03370100_0150
rows.name:
The refugee children you
took in will be sad.

rows.label: bf03370100_0170
rows.name:
What a farce. That line couldn't
be more clichéd.
